metadata.name: kalend
metadata.description: Private request-for-quote exchange for dated yield on Solana, settled through Chainlink CRE

instructions.name: accept_authority
docs: Accepts pending governance authority

instructions.name: claim_yt
docs: Claims accrued yield for settled YT tokens in raw collateral

accounts.name: vault
docs: Raw collateral vault owned by Series PDA

accounts.name: user_yt
docs: User's YT token account to burn from

accounts.name: user_collateral
docs: User's raw collateral destination account

instructions.name: execute_fill
docs: Permissionlessly executes an approved fill using an Address Lookup Table

accounts.name: requester_quote_token
docs: Requester destination account for quote currency (must be owned by the requester:
execute_fill is permissionless, so the caller must not choose where funds go)

accounts.name: dealer_asset_token
docs: Dealer destination account for asset currency (PT or YT), owned by the dealer

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Initializes protocol global Config, Registry, and RentVault PDA

instructions.name: lock_escrow
docs: Locks tokens into a program-owned Escrow PDA

accounts.name: allow_entry
docs: AllowEntry validating the user has Requester, Dealer, or Strip permissions

accounts.name: escrow_token
docs: Escrow token account owned by Escrow PDA (canonical ATA)

accounts.name: owner_token
docs: Owner token source account

instructions.name: merge
docs: Merges equal PT and YT tokens before maturity, releasing 1:1 raw collateral

accounts.name: vault
docs: Raw collateral vault owned by Series PDA

accounts.name: user_collateral
docs: User's raw collateral destination account

accounts.name: user_pt
docs: User's PT source account

accounts.name: user_yt
docs: User's YT source account

instructions.name: on_report
docs: Receives and processes reports from Chainlink Keystone Forwarder CPI

accounts.name: forwarder_authority
docs: Signer PDA derived by the forwarder: ["forwarder", forwarderState, receiverProgram]

instructions.name: open_series
docs: Deploys a new dated yield Series with PT/YT Token-2022 mints

accounts.name: collateral_mint
docs: Raw collateral mint

accounts.name: collateral_token_program
docs: Program owning the collateral mint (Token or Token-2022)

accounts.name: quote_mint
docs: Quote asset mint

accounts.name: pt_mint
docs: Principal Token (PT) Token-2022 mint

accounts.name: yt_mint
docs: Yield Token (YT) Token-2022 mint

accounts.name: vault
docs: Vault account holding raw collateral (canonical ATA owned by Series PDA)

instructions.name: pause_global
docs: Toggles global protocol pause

instructions.name: pause_series
docs: Toggles pause on an individual Series

instructions.name: propose_authority
docs: Proposes a new governance authority (two-step transfer)

instructions.name: redeem_pt
docs: Redeems settled PT tokens for in-kind raw principal collateral

accounts.name: vault
docs: Raw collateral vault owned by Series PDA

accounts.name: user_pt
docs: User's PT token account to burn from

accounts.name: user_collateral
docs: User's raw collateral destination account

instructions.name: remove_allow_entry
docs: Closes an AllowEntry account

instructions.name: set_allow_entry
docs: Sets or updates a wallet's AllowEntry permissions and expiration

instructions.name: set_enclave_key_hash
docs: Publishes the hash of the active enclave HPKE public key

instructions.name: set_forwarder_entry
docs: Updates or registers a forwarder entry in Config

instructions.name: settle_onchain
docs: Permissionless onchain settlement crank for StakePoolRate series

instructions.name: strip
docs: Strips raw collateral into equal 1:1 PT and YT tokens

accounts.name: allow_entry
docs: AllowEntry validating the user has the Strip role

accounts.name: vault
docs: Raw collateral vault owned by Series PDA

accounts.name: user_collateral
docs: User's raw collateral source account

accounts.name: user_pt
docs: User's PT destination account

accounts.name: user_yt
docs: User's YT destination account

instructions.name: withdraw_escrow
docs: Withdraws tokens from Escrow PDA after lock_until expires

accounts.name: escrow_token
docs: Escrow token account owned by Escrow PDA (canonical ATA)

accounts.name: owner_token
docs: Owner destination token account

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Unauthorized: Caller is not the authorized protocol authority

errors.name: PendingAuthorityMismatch
errors.msg: PendingAuthorityMismatch: Caller is not the designated pending authority

errors.name: ProtocolPaused
errors.msg: ProtocolPaused: Protocol is currently paused by governance

errors.name: SeriesPaused
errors.msg: SeriesPaused: Target series is currently paused

errors.name: SeriesNotOpen
errors.msg: SeriesNotOpen: Series status is not Open

errors.name: SeriesAlreadySettled
errors.msg: SeriesAlreadySettled: Series is already settled

errors.name: SeriesMaturityNotReached
errors.msg: SeriesMaturityNotReached: Cannot settle series prior to maturity timestamp

errors.name: SeriesAlreadyMatured
errors.msg: SeriesAlreadyMatured: Cannot strip or merge series at or after maturity timestamp

errors.name: SeriesNotSettled
errors.msg: SeriesNotSettled: Redemptions and claims require settled series

errors.name: MaturityInPast
errors.msg: MaturityInPast: Series maturity timestamp must be in the future

errors.name: InvalidCollateralMint
errors.msg: InvalidCollateralMint: Collateral mint does not conform to extension safety policy

errors.name: DisallowedCollateralExtension
errors.msg: DisallowedCollateralExtension: Mint carries a forbidden Token-2022 extension

errors.name: InvalidAllowEntry
errors.msg: InvalidAllowEntry: Wallet has no valid or active AllowEntry

errors.name: AllowEntryExpired
errors.msg: AllowEntryExpired: AllowEntry has passed its expiration timestamp

errors.name: MissingRole
errors.msg: MissingRole: Wallet lacks the required role bit for this instruction

errors.name: EscrowLocked
errors.msg: EscrowLocked: Escrow funds cannot be withdrawn before lock_until timestamp

errors.name: InsufficientEscrowBalance
errors.msg: InsufficientEscrowBalance: Escrow does not hold sufficient tokens

errors.name: InvalidForwarderProgram
errors.msg: InvalidForwarderProgram: Forwarder program is not registered in Config

errors.name: InvalidForwarderState
errors.msg: InvalidForwarderState: Forwarder state account does not match registered forwarder

errors.name: InvalidForwarderAuthority
errors.msg: InvalidForwarderAuthority: forwarder_authority signer does not match PDA derivation

errors.name: InvalidWorkflowIdentity
errors.msg: InvalidWorkflowIdentity: Workflow ID or owner does not match allowed forwarder entry

errors.name: InvalidReportPayload
errors.msg: InvalidReportPayload: Malformed or unparseable report payload

errors.name: TrailingReportBytes
errors.msg: TrailingReportBytes: Trailing bytes detected after decoding report payload

errors.name: UnsupportedReportVersion
errors.msg: UnsupportedReportVersion: Report version is not supported

errors.name: UnknownReportKind
errors.msg: UnknownReportKind: Report kind must be 1 (Fill), 2 (Settle), or 3 (Rate)

errors.name: RateExceedsCap
errors.msg: RateExceedsCap: Implied or observed rate exceeds series max_rate_bps cap

errors.name: DividendBandExceeded
errors.msg: DividendBandExceeded: Dividend growth index outside configured band; series disputed

errors.name: RoundExpired
errors.msg: RoundExpired: Fill report received after not_after timestamp expiration

errors.name: FillAlreadyExecuted
errors.msg: FillAlreadyExecuted: Fill receipt has already been executed

errors.name: FillNotApproved
errors.msg: FillNotApproved: Fill receipt is not in Approved status

errors.name: SeriesMismatch
errors.msg: SeriesMismatch: Series specified does not match FillReceipt or report

errors.name: TokenMismatch
errors.msg: TokenMismatch: Escrow or mint token account does not match series specifications

errors.name: PartyMismatch
errors.msg: PartyMismatch: Wallet does not match requester or dealer in FillReceipt

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: MathOverflow: Arithmetic calculation encountered an overflow or division by zero

errors.name: InvalidIndex
errors.msg: InvalidIndex: Settlement index must be positive

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: ZeroAmount: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: RegistryFull
errors.msg: RegistryFull: Series registry has reached its maximum limit (64 series)

errors.name: MockForwarderForbidden
errors.msg: MockForwarderForbidden: Mock forwarder address is strictly rejected in mainnet builds

errors.name: ConfidentialModeUnavailable
errors.msg: ConfidentialModeUnavailable: Confidential PT/YT mints are not implemented yet; open a Plain series

fields.name: wallet
docs: Whitelisted wallet address

fields.name: expiry_ts
docs: Unix timestamp when this allow entry expires

fields.name: roles
docs: Bitmask of permitted actions (see roles module)

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed

fields.name: authority
docs: Protocol governance authority

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: Pending authority for two-step transfer

fields.name: forwarders
docs: Registered forwarders (up to 2: on Devnet, 1 live Keystone + 1 mock simulator forwarder)

fields.name: forwarder_count
docs: Number of active forwarders in the array

fields.name: enclave_key_hash
docs: Published SHA-256 hash of the TEE enclave X25519 public key

fields.name: paused
docs: Global emergency pause flag

fields.name: cluster_mode
docs: Cluster mode: 0 = Local, 1 = Devnet, 2 = Mainnet

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Protocol fee in basis points (0 for v1)

fields.name: treasury
docs: Protocol fee treasury

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed

fields.name: owner
docs: Owner wallet that deposited the escrowed tokens

fields.name: series
docs: Associated series PDA

fields.name: mint
docs: Token mint held in escrow (PT, YT, or quote token)

fields.name: lock_until
docs: Unix timestamp before which the owner cannot withdraw

fields.name: amount
docs: Current quantity of tokens locked in escrow

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed

fields.name: round_id
docs: Unique round ID (32 bytes), acts as the global replay guard

fields.name: series
docs: Series PDA traded in this fill

fields.name: requester
docs: Requester wallet address

fields.name: dealer
docs: Winning dealer wallet address

fields.name: side
docs: 0 = SellPT, 1 = SellYT

fields.name: asset_amount
docs: Quantity of asset tokens (PT or YT) filled

fields.name: quote_amount
docs: Quantity of quote tokens paid

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: Quote currency mint

fields.name: ts
docs: Unix timestamp of receipt creation

fields.name: report_hash
docs: Hash of the signed forwarder report

fields.name: status
docs: Fill lifecycle status: 0 = Approved, 1 = Executed

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed

fields.name: program
docs: Keystone forwarder program address

fields.name: state
docs: Keystone forwarder state account

fields.name: allowed_workflow
docs: Authorized workflow ID (32 bytes) that may submit reports through this forwarder

fields.name: count
docs: Active series count

fields.name: series
docs: Up to 64 active series pubkeys

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed

fields.name: collateral_mint
docs: Collateral token mint (Token or Token-2022)

fields.name: collateral_program
docs: Token program owning the collateral mint (Token or Token-2022)

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: Denominated quote currency mint (e.g. wSOL for staking, USDC for equities)

fields.name: index_kind
docs: Yield index type: 0 = StakePoolRate, 1 = ScaledUiDividendAdjusted, 2 = OracleIndex

fields.name: index_source
docs: Source account or pubkey for the index (e.g. stake pool account or price feed)

fields.name: idx_open
docs: Index value at series opening, scaled by WAD (1e18)

fields.name: open_ts
docs: Unix timestamp when the series was created

fields.name: maturity_ts
docs: Unix timestamp when the series reaches maturity

fields.name: pt_mint
docs: Principal Token (PT) Token-2022 mint address

fields.name: yt_mint
docs: Yield Token (YT) Token-2022 mint address

fields.name: vault
docs: Vault account (ATA) owned by this Series PDA holding raw collateral

fields.name: status
docs: Current lifecycle status: 0 = Open, 1 = Settled, 2 = Disputed, 3 = Paused

fields.name: idx_settle
docs: Settled index value scaled by WAD (1e18)

fields.name: split_num
docs: Cumulative corporate split factor numerator (1 if no split)

fields.name: split_den
docs: Cumulative corporate split factor denominator (1 if no split)

fields.name: settled_ts
docs: Unix timestamp when settlement occurred

fields.name: privacy_mode
docs: Privacy mode: 0 = Plain, 1 = Confidential (immutable)

fields.name: max_rate_bps
docs: Maximum allowable annualized rate in basis points (sanity cap)

fields.name: dividend_cap_bps
docs: Maximum allowable dividend increase in basis points (sanity cap for equities)

fields.name: nonce
docs: Nonce to allow distinct series with the same collateral and maturity

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed
